correctness.rationale: All 18 edge faults form two verified S4 orbits; exact exhaustive vertex-subset enumeration and signed chain complexes determine both metrics. Replayed free-face collapse certificates reduce radius two to simply connected 2-complexes with Euler characteristics four and three, proving wedges of three and two integral 2-spheres by Hurewicz-Whitehead; full free-face collapses make radius three and later contractible. Unimodular unit-only integer row/column reductions show fault second-homology lattices map injectively and primitively into the intact five-sphere homology, with cokernel ranks two and three.
